competitive_items.name: Leftovers
competitive_items.desc: Restores 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn.

competitive_items.name: Life Orb
competitive_items.desc: Attacks do 1.3x damage at the cost of 10% max HP.

competitive_items.name: Focus Sash
competitive_items.desc: Survives a lethal hit from 100% HP with 1 HP remaining.

competitive_items.name: Choice Scarf
competitive_items.desc: Multiplies Speed by 1.5x, locks user into first move chosen.

competitive_items.name: Sitrus Berry
competitive_items.desc: Restores 25% max HP when falling below 50% HP.

competitive_items.name: Lum Berry
competitive_items.desc: Cures any major status condition or confusion immediately.

competitive_items.name: Rocky Helmet
competitive_items.desc: Inflicts 1/6 max HP recoil on attacker making contact.

competitive_items.name: Assault Vest
competitive_items.desc: Raises Sp. Def by 1.5x but prevents using status moves.

competitive_items.name: Heavy-Duty Boots
competitive_items.desc: Protects the holder from hazards on entry.

competitive_items.name: Clear Amulet
competitive_items.desc: Prevents stat drops caused by other Pokémon (e.g. Intimidate).

competitive_items.name: Loaded Dice
competitive_items.desc: Multi-hit moves always strike 4-5 times.

competitive_items.name: Air Balloon
competitive_items.desc: Grants immunity to Ground attacks until popped by damage.

competitive_items.name: Expert Belt
competitive_items.desc: Attacks that deal super effective damage do 1.2x damage.

competitive_items.name: Choice Band
competitive_items.desc: Multiplies Attack by 1.5x, locks user into one move.

competitive_items.name: Choice Specs
competitive_items.desc: Multiplies Sp. Atk by 1.5x, locks user into one move.

competitive_items.name: Dark Rock
competitive_items.desc: Extends New Moon weather duration from 5 to 8 turns.

competitive_items.name: Damp Rock
competitive_items.desc: Extends Rain duration from 5 to 8 turns.

competitive_items.name: Heat Rock
competitive_items.desc: Extends Sun duration from 5 to 8 turns.

competitive_items.name: Smooth Rock
competitive_items.desc: Extends Sandstorm duration from 5 to 8 turns.

competitive_items.name: Icy Rock
competitive_items.desc: Extends Hail/Snow duration from 5 to 8 turns.
